body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CRM example seed data lookup resolution by switching foreign key values from internal `id`-style strings (e.g., `"o1"`, `"2"`) to the target records’ natural key (`name`) values, aligning with `SeedLoaderService`’s default external-id behavior so lookup columns render correctly in the CRM grids.

**Changes:**
- Updated CRM seed datasets to use `name` values for single-value lookup fields (orders, products, accounts, contacts, users).
- Fixed Order Item grid lookups (Order/Product) by making referenced values resolvable during seeding.
- Added a CHANGELOG entry documenting the seed data compatibility fix.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/src/data/account.data.ts | Updates `owner` lookup values to user `name` values for SeedLoader resolution. |
| examples/crm/src/data/contact.data.ts | Updates `account` lookup values to account `name` values. |
| examples/crm/src/data/event.data.ts | Updates `organizer` lookup values to user `name` values. |
| examples/crm/src/data/opportunity_contact.data.ts | Updates `opportunity` and `contact` lookup values to their `name` values. |
| examples/crm/src/data/opportunity.data.ts | Updates `account` lookup values to account `name` values. |
| examples/crm/src/data/order.data.ts | Updates `customer` (contact) and `account` lookups to `name` values. |
| examples/crm/src/data/order_item.data.ts | Updates `order` and `product` lookups to `name` values, fixing empty lookup display in the grid. |
| examples/crm/src/data/project_task.data.ts | Updates `manager`/`assignee` lookups to user `name` values. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the seed data lookup reference fix under Unreleased → Fixed. |
</details>
